# Collective_State_Convergence

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process by which a multi-agent or many-body system reaches a stable global state through ordered local interactions. Critical for ensuring that neuromorphic networks achieve reliable computation despite distributed and asynchronous processing.
